loginIntro: Log in with Discord to manage the bot in servers where you have Manage Server.
loginFailed: Logging in didn't work. Please try again.
serversNone: You don't manage any server the bot is in yet.
staffRoleHelp: Can use /country-staff, and moderate when no mod role is set.
modRoleHelp: Can use every moderation command without the Discord permission.
countryChannelHelp: Only allow /country here. Every other message posted there is deleted.
logsChannelHelp: Everything members do with the bot, and every change made here.
serverLogChannelHelp: Edited and deleted messages, joins, leaves and member changes.
logEventsHelp: Untick an event to stop logging it.
ignoredChannelsHelp: Messages in ticked channels, their threads, and channels in ticked categories aren't logged.
deleteConfirm: Delete case #{number}? This can't be undone.
errorGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errorForbidden: You need Manage Server in this server.
errorNotFound: Not found. The bot may have left this server.
errorTooFast: Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.
appearanceHelp: Pick how the dashboard looks. This is saved in this browser only.
serversIntro: Pick a server to see its activity, cases and settings.
casesOnlyNote: You can see this server through a dashboard role, so you can view and edit cases but not settings.
overviewIntro: Moderation activity over the last 30 days, and what's left to set up.
setupModLog: Choose where moderation cases are posted
setupDashboard: Let a role open the dashboard
moderationIntro: Who can moderate, and where moderation cases are posted.
loggingIntro: Where the bot keeps its records, and what the server log watches.
logEventHelp_messageDelete: The full message, with its attachments.
logEventHelp_bulkDelete: When many messages are removed at once.
countryIntro: Where members can use /country to show where they're from.
accessIntro: Who can open this dashboard, and an overview of every role in the server.
dashboardAccessHelp: Members with a ticked role can open this dashboard to see the overview and view and edit cases. Only people with Manage Server can change settings.
allRolesHelp: Highest role first. Badges show the strongest permissions each role has.
casesIntro: Search, filter, edit and export every moderation case.
leaveUnsaved: You have unsaved changes. Leave this page anyway?
overviewIntroCases: Moderation activity over the last 30 days.
automodIntro: Catch spam, invite links and banned words before your moderators have to.
amMasterHelp: The main switch. The rules below only work while this is on.
amAlwaysExempt: Bots, moderators (Manage Messages or the mod role) and the /country channel are never checked.
amRulesHelp: Each rule deletes the message it catches and tells the member why. Choose whether it also warns or times them out.
amRuleHelp_bannedWords: Messages containing a word from your list.
amRuleHelp_invites: Discord invite links to other servers. Invites to this server are fine.
amRuleHelp_links: Links to websites that aren't on your allowed list.
amRuleHelp_mentions: Messages that mention too many members or roles at once.
amRuleHelp_spam: Too many messages in a few seconds. All of them are deleted.
amRuleHelp_duplicates: The same message sent again and again within a minute.
amRuleHelp_caps: Messages written mostly in capital letters.
amWordsHelp: One word or phrase per line. Put * at the start or end to also catch longer words (bad* catches badly). Capitals, accents and swaps like 4 for a don't hide a word.
amSitesHelp: One per line, like youtube.com. Subdomains count too. GIFs (Tenor) and Discord links are always allowed.
amCapsMinLength: Only messages with at least this many letters
amTimeoutMinutesHelp: For rules set to Delete and time out.
amEscalationWarningsHelp: Counted over 24 hours, including warnings from moderators. 0 turns this off.
amExemptRolesHelp: Trusted members, like boosters or content creators.
amExemptChannelsHelp: Ticked channels, their threads and channels in ticked categories aren't checked.
communityIntro: Greet new players, say goodbye, hand out starter roles and see your role panels.
welcomeChannelHelp: Where the bot greets new members. Off means no welcome message.
messagePlaceholdersHelp: Leave empty for the default. You can use {user} (a mention), {username}, {server} and {count}.
welcomeDmHelp: A private message new members get when they join, like where to find the rules. Leave empty for none.
leaveChannelHelp: Where the bot posts when someone leaves. Off means no leave message.
autorolesHelp: Roles every new member gets (up to {max}). Members who must accept the rules first get them once they do. Bot and admin roles aren't listed.
rolePanelsHelp: Messages with buttons where members pick their own roles. Make and change them in Discord with /rolepanel.
rolePanelsNone: No role panels yet. Try /rolepanel create in Discord.
rolePanelsEmpty: No roles on this panel yet
onboardingTip: This is a Community server, so we recommend Discord's own Onboarding (Server Settings → Onboarding) for giving new members roles. Use autoroles only if you don't use Onboarding.
rolePanelsOnboardingTip: This is a Community server, so we recommend Discord's own Onboarding (Server Settings → Onboarding) for letting members pick roles. Role panels are best for servers that don't use Onboarding.
tagsIntro: Saved answers anyone can post with /tag.
tagsHelp: Names use letters, numbers and dashes. Staff can also manage these in Discord with /tags.
tagsNone: No custom commands yet. Add one to get started.
starboardHelp: When a message gets enough stars, the bot reposts it in the starboard channel with a link back. The author's own star and bots don't count.
starboardChannelHelp: Off turns the starboard off. Messages from channels everyone can't see never go on a public starboard.
starboardEmojiHelp: ⭐ by default. A custom emoji looks like <:name:123…>.
membersIntro: Look up anyone, including people who left, and see their whole history in one place.
memberSearchHelp: Names find people in the server (the start of a username or nickname). Paste a user ID to find someone who left.
memberSearchNone: Nobody found. Try the start of their name, or paste their user ID.
memberTimesJoinedSub: Counted since the bot started recording
memberNoEvents: No joins or leaves recorded yet.
memberMoreCases: Showing the newest {count}. Open them in Cases to see all.
memberJoinsLeavesHelp: The newest 50 are kept for each person.
levelsIntro: Members earn XP for chatting and level up. Reward roles are given automatically when they reach a level.
levelsMasterHelp: Off by default. XP already earned is kept when you turn it off.
levelsHowXp: Each message earns 15 to 25 XP, at most once a minute per member, so spamming doesn't pay. Bots and the /country channel never earn XP.
levelsAnnounce_here: In the channel they're chatting in
levelsMessageHelp: Leave empty for the default. You can use {user} (a mention), {username}, {level} and {server}.
levelsRewardsHelp: Roles members get when they reach a level. The bot's own role must be above them.
levelsStackHelp: On: members keep every reward role they reached. Off: only the highest one.
levelsNoXpChannelsHelp: Messages here earn nothing. Picking a category covers every channel in it.
levelsNoXpRolesHelp: Members with any of these roles earn nothing.
levelsBoardHelp: {count} members have XP. Members see the same list with /leaderboard.
ticketsIntro: Every support ticket, open and closed. Closed tickets keep the whole conversation as a transcript.
ticketsSummaryNoPanel: {count} open right now. There's no Open a ticket button yet: post one with /tickets panel.
ticketsNoTranscript: No transcript was saved for this ticket. It was closed before transcripts existed, or its thread was deleted.
ticketsTranscriptLater: The transcript is saved when the ticket is closed.
raidHelp: Kick or flag brand-new accounts when they join, and get an alert in the mod log when many people join at once. During a raid, /raid lockdown locks every public channel and /raid end puts them back. Discord's verification level and raid alerts (Server Settings → Safety Setup) work alongside these.
raidLockdownActive: A lockdown is running since {date} ({count} channels locked). End it with /raid end in Discord.
gateAlertJoins: Alert when this many join in a minute
respondersHelp: The bot replies when a message matches a trigger. In replies, {user} mentions the author (no ping), {server} and {channel} are filled in. Each one answers at most once every 30 seconds per channel. Staff can also use /autoresponder.
responderReplyPlaceholder: Hi {user}! The download link is in #downloads.
scheduledIntro: Messages the bot posts later, once or on repeat: event reminders, weekly updates, rules refreshers.
scheduledContentPlaceholder: Tournament check-in opens in one hour! React in #events to join.
scheduledContentHelp: Mentions only ping if you have Mention Everyone.
scheduledPast: Pick a time in the future.
scheduledHelp: Next first. Staff can also use /schedule in Discord.
birthdaysHelp: Members save their birthday with /birthday set (month and day, no year). When the day starts, the bot posts a greeting and gives the birthday role until the next day. Pick a channel, a role, or both.
birthdayRoleHelp: Given for the day. Roles with moderator permissions aren't listed.
birthdayTimezoneHelp: When the day starts, like Europe/London or America/Toronto.
birthdayMessageHelp: {user} is the member (several on the same day are listed together), {server} the server. Leave empty for the default.
levelsVoiceHelp: 10 XP a minute in voice with at least one other person, unless deafened or in the AFK channel. No-XP channels and roles count here too.
levelsBoosterHelp: XP multiplier for members boosting the server, from 1 (none) to 5.
levelsBoostsHelp: Roles that earn more XP. A member gets their highest boost (booster or role); boosts don't multiply each other.
activityIntro: Every change made on this dashboard: who made it, when, and what changed.
activityNone: Nothing has been changed on the dashboard yet.
raidIntro: Screen brand-new accounts, get warned about join waves, and lock the server down in one command.
raidGateHelp: Kick or flag accounts younger than the age you set when they join.
raidLockdownHelp: During a raid, /raid lockdown locks every public channel and /raid end puts them back exactly as they were. Discord's own verification level and raid alerts (Server Settings → Safety Setup) work alongside these.
welcomeIntro: Greet new players in a channel or by DM, and say goodbye when someone leaves.
rolesIntro: Roles every new member gets on joining, and the role panels posted with /rolepanel.
respondersIntro: Automatic replies when a message contains certain words. Good for questions people ask every day.
searchPlaceholder: Jump to a page or server
search_activity: audit history changes log who changed
search_cases: warn ban kick timeout mute punishments history
search_automod: spam invites links bad words filter caps mentions
search_raid: raid lockdown join gate account age alt
search_welcome: greet join leave goodbye message dm
search_roles: autorole role panel buttons reaction roles onboarding
search_scheduled: schedule timer repeat announcement post later
search_moderation: staff mod roles mod log quarantine
antinukeIntro: Stops someone with staff permissions, or a hacked bot, from wiping out channels, roles or members.
antinukeMasterHelp: When someone goes over a limit below, the bot acts at once and alerts the mod log and the server owner. The owner and this bot are never limited.
antinukePunishment: When someone goes over a limit
antinukePunishmentHelp: Bots are always kicked, since their own role can't be taken away.
antinukeLimitsHelp: How many of each one person may do in a minute. Bans and kicks done with the bot's commands count too.
antinukeTrustedHelp: Co-owners or bots you trust to go over the limits. Paste their user ID (right-click → Copy User ID).
antinukeOwnerOnly: Only the server owner can change anti-nuke, since trusted people can do anything.
search_antinuke: nuke wick protection mass delete ban trusted whitelist
memberQuarantineInfo: Quarantined with {count} role(s) saved. /quarantine release gives them back.
quarantineRoleHelp: Given to members quarantined with /quarantine or by anti-nuke, after their roles are taken. Make it a role that can only see one channel.
persistEnabled: Give roles back when members rejoin
persistHelp: The bot remembers members' roles when they leave, so leaving can't shake off a restricted role. Roles with moderator permissions, bot roles and roles above the bot are never given back automatically.
